title: Authority without a flat is redirected from /dashboard to /onboarding ("Your details and flat")
steps: Sign in as 9000000014 (secretary, no flat_id); open /dashboard
actual: Redirected to /onboarding with h1 "Your details and flat"; other admin pages remain reachable

title: Switched-off features are only hidden from the sidebar; their pages open by direct URL
steps: QA Sunrise Heights has only visitors, staff_directory, directory, polls switched on (society_features). Sign in as 9000000014; open /bookings, /facilities, /community, /flat-actions
expected: Page blocked or "feature not enabled" message; server/RPC refuses
actual: All four render HTTP 200 with full UI; page.jsx files only check user + society; no migration checks society_features before module RPCs

title: New complaints do not appear in the board list in realtime
steps: Authority 15 opens /complaints. Owner 18 files a complaint. Wait 12 s.
expected: Card appears without reload (list subscribes to complaints INSERT)
actual: Card appears only after reload. complaints is in the supabase_realtime publication; complaint_responses events do arrive, so the complaints row events appear filtered (likely RLS on complaints vs realtime JWT claims)

title: Reporter's status badge does not update live when board responds (core loop)
steps: Owner 18 opens own complaint. Authority 15 clicks 'Will resolve soon'. Wait 12 s.
expected: Badge changes Open -> Will resolve soon
actual: Trail entry appears live but badge stays 'Open'; list also stays 'Open' until reload

title: Replaced or abandoned complaint photos stay in storage; image content not validated
steps: Attach big.jpg (6 MB random bytes), then attach photo.png, submit
expected: Only the kept photo stored; invalid image rejected
actual: 6 MB invalid .jpg remains in parisar-attachments (no attachments row). Upload happens on selection, so abandoned forms also leave orphans. No client resize/compression
